import pathlib
programs=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs'); programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Fill each rectangular zero canvas by periodically repeating the colored seed motif.
    for color in sorted(set(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (0,8))):
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==color]
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        # Seed tile is the non-background bounding box of this color.
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        # Locate the adjacent blank rectangle containing this seed.
        # Expand through connected 0 cells; each puzzle canvas is an axis-aligned region.
        rs,cs=set(),set()
        for r in range(len(grid)):
            if any(grid[r][c]==0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)): rs.add(r)
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if any(grid[r][c]==0 for r in range(r0,r1+1)): cs.add(c)
        # Canvas boundaries are the contiguous zero zone extending from seed bounds.
        top,bottom,left,right=r0,r1,c0,c1
        while top>0 and any(grid[top-1][c]==0 for c in range(left,right+1)): top-=1
        while bottom+1<len(grid) and any(grid[bottom+1][c]==0 for c in range(left,right+1)): bottom+=1
        while left>0 and any(grid[r][left-1]==0 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): left-=1
        while right+1<len(grid[0]) and any(grid[r][right+1]==0 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): right+=1
        for r in range(top,bottom+1):
            for c in range(left,right+1):
                sr=r0+(r-r0)%h; sc=c0+(c-c0)%w
                if grid[sr][sc]==color: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
